final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT City, COUNT(*) as count FROM Employee WHERE City IS NOT NULL GROUP BY City), summary AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_sum, AVG(count) as avg_count FROM city_counts) SELECT cc.City, cc.count, CAST(cc.count AS FLOAT) / s.total_sum as count_div_sum, CAST(cc.count AS FLOAT) / s.avg_count as count_div_avg FROM city_counts cc CROSS JOIN summary s
